title: Indirections
description: Where the solution addresses objects through a computed name, number or text instead of a fixed reference: Perform Script by name, Go to Layout by calculation, Set Field By Name, Go to Object by name, Evaluate, GetField, ExecuteSQL with names in the SQL text or a statement built at run time, design functions with object names. Such references carry no edge in the object graph — where-used, renaming, the unused-object rules and the module clustering cannot see them. Literals are resolved against the catalog: a fixed reference would be possible, or the target is missing.
author: fm-lab

defaultResult.name: indirection_count
defaultResult.meaning: Number of indirect references (without introspection and window names)

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter (from the app-level filter).

params.name: kind
params.description: Target type: script, layout, field, table, sql, layout_object, value_list, formula, introspection, window. 'all' (or empty) shows every type except introspection and window.

params.name: resolution
params.description: Resolution class: dynamic, literal_resolved, literal_unresolved, literal_external, empty, no_target. 'all' (or empty) lifts the filter.

params.name: mechanism
params.description: Restricts the lists to one mechanism (M01 … M70, see the mechanism table).

params.name: disabled
params.description: Disabled script steps and formula slots: 'hide' (default) or 'include'.
